target_claim: $$\sum_{1\leq m^+ + m^- \leq 17}\binom{17}{m^+ + m^-}\binom{m^+ + m^-}{m^+}\left(\frac{1}{2^{m^+ + m^-}}\binom{m^+ + m^-}{m^+}\right)^{10} that is true by direct computation.
